name: BenQ Materials Corporation
summary: BenQ Materials Corporation manufactures and sells film sheet products and medical equipment in China, Taiwan, Japan, the United States, and internationally. The company engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and sales of various electronic chemical membrane products. It also offers display tech and materials, including polarizer and optical films, touch panels materials, ultra-precision machining products, PDLS smart film displays, and industrial tapes.
